text: Valus Mau'ual is a Cabal commander encountered in the Shield Brothers Strike. He is a bond-brother with both Primus Ta'aun and Valus Tlu'urn, and is part of the landing party aboard Dantalion Exodus VI, the warship that the Skyburners ram into the Dreadnaught. Either as a gambit to compel the Hive to surrender or to avenge the loss of Primus Ta'aun, Mau'ual and Tlu'urn breach the Dreadnaught's power core and threaten to destroy it, which would destroy the Hive vessel and take most of the Solar System with it. In battle, Valus Mau'ual's armor allows him a degree of maneuverability and speed unseen by other Cabal warriors and combined with his Solar-powered gauntlet, it makes him a dangerous adversary.

Valus Tau'ugh is a high-ranking Cabal Colossus who can be encountered in the Hull Breach on the Dreadnaught after activating the Skyburners Command Beacon. They are referred to as the Cabal's Champion.
Vrees, Imprisoned Flayer was a Psion Flayer seen with a pair of other Psion Flayers in the Fields of Glass on Mercury during the Flashpoint.

Brie and the Borrowed Blade is an unreleased webcomic developed as a collaboration between Webtoon & Wizards of the Coast. It was intended to tell the story of Briennelle Zaharina, daughter of Drizzt Do'Urden, and be set in the Forgotten Realms.
Voxon, Respite Mind was a large Vex Minotaur and one of many, extremely resilient bosses encountered at the end of the Verdant Forest activity.
Val Drueng was a Cabal Colossus seen in the Warsat Down Heroic in the BrayTech Futurescape during the Mars Flashpoint.

Valus Tharum, Gladiatorial Overseer is a large Cabal Colossus and Valus of the Shadow Legion who oversees the gladiatorial fights that take place in the Gilded Precept Lost Sector, and acts as the boss of the area. He fights much like a normal large Colossus.

Bronzewood cuauhchimalli and their more powerful variant, exalted BBronzewood cuauhchimalli, were a variety of artifact shield created to be used by paladin adventurers in the Chultan city of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15 century DR.

Valus Gathurn is a Major Cabal Colossus, Valus of the Shadow Legion, that coordinated troop movements in the Esi Terminal. They were marked as a target by Tse Jingye, and the Guardian sought them out and slew them, with the intent of ruining the Legion's morale.

Xirash, Keeper of Memory is a large and powerful Hive Knight of the Lucent Brood, charged with protecting the Altar of Reflection. They are encountered as the final boss of the Missions Memories of Loss and Altar of Reflection: Choice.
The Wretched Abomination is a powerful Scorn Abomination that attempted to breach into the Monument of the Temple of the Navigator.

The Brothers of the Sword was an organization from Veldergauttland in the Whamite Isles. They represented Veldergauttland in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

Zatocc, Devoted to the Witness is a Psion Flayer of the Shadow Legion that acts as the warden for the Shadow Legion Prison of the Cosmodrome. They guarded the many prisoners brought into the facility by the Legion. They predicted the arrival of a Fireteam of Guardians and prepared several ambushes, but the Lightbearers still slew them in a fierce battle.

Ebewaka was an individual, apparently a Spiritborn, who gained the favor of twelve Spirit Guardians; a feat that no-one else has been able to match. When Ebewaka died, the Spirit Guardians waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.
Gorejaw is a super unique Hulking Varanid seen in Diablo Immortal. It is the boss of the side quest "Carnivore's Dilemma".
The brilliant staff of the legendary wizard was a unque enchanted wizardly staff used by Dhadius the Scarlet of the Arcane Brotherhood, during his adventuring days in the late 15 century DR.

The Guardian Golem is a type of golem enemy in Diablo Immortal. It is located in the Library of Zoltun Kulle. The Guardian has four arms, two of which hold a giant stone shield, the other two it uses to attack. It is advisable to attack the Guardian from the side or rear if possible.

Gulag was a dimwitted but powerful minion of Baal. He was summoned by Lucion to assist him in casting a spell upon Lilith. Gulag appears in the first two novels of the Sin War series by Richard A. Knaak.
Ikonoth was a demon prince of Hell, who slew hundreds of angels with his infernal hammer. He was finally slain by Imperius.

The Broadback was a river barge used as a prison ship by the city of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR, one in a fleet of three that included the Golden Ball and the Lasher. The city's magistrates sentenced serious and violent criminals to the fleet, namely killers and robbers. Life on the hulks was brutal and grisly; being sentenced to any of the hulks was considered tantamount to a death sentence.
The , simply called The Immortal, is the leader of the Immortals and the bearer of the Eternal Crown.
Izilech the Misshapen was a powerful demon lord, and leader of the Wrathborne.

Irina Coldheart is a (fictional?) individual mentioned in Greenslade's Tales. In the work's seventh chapter, it is stated that as her lover's spirit faded, she wept frozen tears. When they fell, roses of the purest ice would blossom each winter.

Burning blade is among the most complex spells learned by swordmage initiates and is used most commonly by those who invoke the assault style of arcane swordplay. When a swordmage casts burning blade he or she transmutes their sword's surface into flames, making it more deadly upon contact with the flesh of a swordmage's foe. The initial power of the spell is largely determined by a swordmage's intellect but the effect of the spell can continue for up to several minutes, during which time the intensity of the flames is dependent instead upon the swordmage's physical strength. Burning blade is fairly difficult to cast and, as such, can only be used once per day.
Kodi, Lost to Madness is a unique Wanted Corrupted Mauler encountered in Diablo Immortal. Kodi appears as a giant bear. It attacks primarily through melee.
Maka was a Spiritborn, and a member of the Council of Kurast. In her youth, she trained under Eru.

Myken was a famous Sorcerer from the island nation of Uie, known for his vitriolic demeanor. One day, at the height of a fevered tirade, the magical embodiment of his wrath burst from his body, granting the spellcaster a serenity that he'd missed for years. His rage took the form of an orb, and many sought it for its destructive power.
Caleb was a male human bandit of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Murkolt was a giant even among the Ancients and was known for many feats and is without remorse. His combat prowess earned him a legendary reputation among the barbarians. His mighty weapon, Remorseless, is a unique mace and is said to embody his ethos, and some even believe it can summon his spirit for a brief time.
Vortex Lords are a type of megademon, appearing in Diablo I. They are found on the lowest cavern level and on the outskirts of Hell. They are Immune to Fire and colored in light blue.

Eater Eve is a digital lifeform. It is the form an Eater (Pure Breed Mode) takes after attacking Yuuko Kamishiro. Attacks *Mastermind Port: Drains energy from Yuuko to unleash a giant ball of energy. *Memory Divide: Slashes with its central blade. *Lightweight: Lowers its DEF and raises its SPD.
Cain was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Dorbickmon Darkness Mode (Flarerizamon) is the DigiFuse of Dorbickmon Darkness Mode One and four Flarerizamon, where the Flarerizamon turn into a flaming sword.

ExMaquinamon is a Unique Digimon. It simultaneously possess two DigiCores—one beast and one machine—within a single body. Its body is composed of data with differing natures on its left and right sides, separated clean down the middle. It wields the power of "Escaton". ExMaquinamon remains an enigma, with additional details yet to be uncovered. Attacks *: Forcibly fuses disparate elements into one. This can be used for a wide range of techniques, such as impacting data streams from its left and right hands to trigger explosions, or forcibly fusing incompatible data with an enemy to trigger damage as that data is then rejected by the host.

Greatest Cutemon is the DigiFuse of Cutemon, Dondokomon, Knightmon, the PawnChessmon (White), Beastmon, Kamemon, and Jijimon. Attacks *Sonic Disruptor Wave (Greatest Sonic Wave): Pounds on its drum-torso to unleash a maddening sonic wave.
Calindra was a female human of Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Greymon O is a Digimon. It is an orange version of Greymon (2010 anime).
A dispirited Takuya returns to Earth in the form of Flamemon, and upon discovering that it's the same day he left, he attempts to stop himself from taking the Trailmon.
Kaminarimon is both a spoof and an unreleased Digimon. It has control over lightning.
Caldreth's Cobbling was a shop in the town of Mornbryn's Shield as of the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.

MetalGreymon X is a Cyborg Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. Both its flesh portions and remodelled portions are perfectly well-balanced, possibly because of how intense the power it had obtained was. The "Trident Arm VER 9.9" on its left arm has a control program set in its DigiCore that has been upgraded to its limit, and possesses the energy equivalent of a single shot of "Giga Destroyer" in just one swing, so it is an offensive force that must never be endured in close combat. Attacks *Trident Arm: Launches its tethered Trident Arm to slash or wrap up enemies. *Giga Destroyer: Fires organic missiles from the hatch on part of its chest. *Trident Arm VER. 9.9 *Metal Slash: Slashes with its claw.
MegaGranKuwagamon is a gigantic GranKuwagamon. Attacks Attacks in Digimon Xros Wars: Super Digica Taisen *Mega Blast Scissor

Okuwamon X is an Insect Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. Like Kuwagamon, its instinctive, destructive impulses such as swooping down on non-Virus Digimon without wasting its breath, have increased. The gigantic pincers on its head have transformed into three, and its offensive ability has powered up not by three times that of the original Okuwamon, but rather by its cube. Attacks *Double Scissor Claw (Scissor Arms Ω): Attacks with an enhanced version of "Scissor Arms" that can clip through even a diamond with a . *Double Scissor Claw3 (Scissor Arms Ω3): An enhanced version of "Scissor Arms Ω". *
A bushi was a class of fighter common in Kara-Tur. In Shou Lung, the bushi was known as a chanshi or warrior.

Ouryumon is a Dragon Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It is an imaginary Digimon born from the "Daydream of a DigiCore". It is a form that had even the DigiCore's own creativity released through the Interface on its brow, and digivolved. Possibly because it naturally possessed the ferocious combat data of the "Dragons" and "Generals" of Japanese myth within its DigiCore, the form created by its DigiCore is a "Warrior Dragon", clad in frightening, majestic Japanese armor and holding swords in both of its hands. The left-hand sword is the , and the right-hand sword is the . The blades of the wings on its back are called the . The characters on its swords are their names. Together, its swords are called the . Attacks *: Fires an attack from the Gairyu Sadaijin and Gairyu Udaijin. *: Rampages like the of a mighty river, cutting everything apart while charging the opponent. There is a theory that Ouryumon's "Golden Armor" technique has its roots in Huanglongmon's "Yellow Circle", although it is unconfirmed.

The Reaper is an Ability Synthesis Agent. It is the final form of the D-Reaper, created when all of its remaining Agents fuse in order to use all of their offensive capability, exceeding the limits of the D-Reaper itself. Attacks * *

Revivemon is a Restoration Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to restore. Even if data has been completely destroyed, it can restore it to its original state as long as even a single fragment remains. Attacks *Wonder Genesis (Wunder Genesis, ): Fires a beam that can restore any Appmon to its normal state. *Saving Beam (Saver Strahl, ): Surrounds itself with energy, then fires a beam from the second head.
Caelar Argent, most commonly known as the Shining Lady, was an aasimar who led a crusade through the Sword Coast in the .

With his resolve restored, Takuya returns to the Digital World as Agunimon. Along the way to rescue his friends, who are being held by Ranamon and Mercurymon, he grows in tune with the Digital World and his Spirits.

Splashmon Darkness Mode 1 is a Digimon. It is an enlarged version of Splashmon after it digifuses its Splashers to itself. Attacks *Hydro-Pressure: Shoots water of high pressure and speed from its fingertips.
XrosUpSabmarimon is the DigiFuse of Submarimon and Plesiomon. Attacks *Oxygen Sorrow Blue: Discharges super-compressed oxygen from its drill.
Calathangas was a unique +1 enchanted short sword that inflicted lycanthropy upon its victims, turning them into wererats.
XrosUpBallistamon is the DigiFuse of Ballistamon and Deputymon. Attacks *Heavy the Shot: Fires an energy shot surrounded by sonic waves from the gun on its belly.
XrosUpMervamon is the DigiFuse of Mervamon and Beelzemon (2010 anime). Attacks *Sexy the Cannon: Fires a shot from the cannon on its Medullia arm. *Madness Merry-go-round DX

Zubamon is a Weapon Digimon. It is one of the "Legend-Arms", who are capable of transforming themselves into weapons. A legend about the Legend-Arms goes, "if held by an angel, it will save the world, and if held by a demon, it will destroy the world." Zubamon carries the "Twentiest" data, and often shouts out "I am the Twentiest!" despite not understanding what it means. It despises crookedness, and is constantly seeking sharpness. A day where its battles, jokes, and sharpness turn out well will leave it in high spirits. Zubamon's true power is exhibited while it is in its weapon form. Attacks *Twenty Dive: Charges head-first. *20 Scratch
Calimport Blend Tea was an herbal tea blend popular in Calimshan with its popularity on the rise along the Sword Coast in the late 15 century DR.

The Beast Spirit of Fire (炎のビーストスピリット Honō no Bīsuto Supiritto), also known as the Spirit of Fire B (炎のスピリットB Honō no Supiritto Bī) is one of the twenty Legendary Spirits. It contains the power of Ancient Greymon of the Warrior Ten, and allows its user to evolve into the Beast Form Hybrid Digimon Vritramon. =Appearances=

Kanada Genjo is the main antagonist of Digimon Beatbreak. He was the second "Gold" member of the Five Stars known as "Genjo the Adamantine", and holds Tenma Asuka's life on the line for most of the series. He was later revealed to be a disguised rogue Sanzomon. His appearance was that of a human researcher Sanzomon Cold Hearted while raiding a World Union laboratory. =Evolution= =Profile=
Cairn Blade was an enchanted greatsword that once belonged to Adal Kerrn of Kerrn's Breakers.

Chapter #16 of Digimon Dreamers =Characters= =Summary= Pulsemon introduced himself to Devimon, though the latter misunderstood his nickname, Pal. Nonetheless, Devimon was confident he could defeat Pulsemon, but he then realized Wizarmon was with him, as did Leomon and Ghostmon, the latter of which went to him, with Wizarmon asking them if they were alright. Devimon then tried to run away to warn Phelesmon, but Pulsemon, with his head evolved, rode him, and demanded Devimon to take him to Phelesmon. Devimon then pushed him off, and Pulsemon ended up impaled on the ground head-first, to Kodou Ritsu's fear, though Leomon praised his guts. Leomon then told Wizarmon that he was glad he was back and so would be everyone else. At Leomon and co.'s secret hideout, Mojyamon, Numemon and Tailmon welcomed Wizarmon back. Tailmon asked him if his injuries had healed which he confirmed and added that he was glad they were alright. Mojyamon and Numemon explained that, while Wizarmon was gone, they gave magical lessons and collected information on how to defeat Phelesmon. Pulsemon proclaimed he'd defeat Phelesmon, causing Leomon to ask Wizarmon what was up with him. Wizarmon introduced them to Ritsu and Pal, who helped him get back to Witchelny from the alternate Digital World. Pulsemon once again proclaimed he'd defeat Phelesmon, but Mojyamon doubted that since he looked weak. Pulsemon pointed out he was stronger than he looked and he had his Tamer, Ritsu, with him, though when Numemon asked

The Sanmyojin (三明神 Sanmyōjin, lit. "The Three Wise Spirits) are a group of three powerful feminine Digimon who protect the Ashino Island. They each have authority over a different domain, and assert that Digimon adapting to various environments and evolving is how the world should be. They are all members of the Tentei Hachibushu. The trio are all also members of the Toho Braves Field. =Overview= Three of the Tentei Hachibushu make up the Sanmyojin, namely Amaterasumon, Kaguyamon, and Ryugumon. These three protect the their respective domains of Ashino Island. Amaterasumon rules the sun of Shambala and oversees the skies of Ashino Island. It usually lives in an area above the clouds called . If there is an emergency or whenever its feelings get hurt, it transforms the ornaments on its arms and turns into its , and since it cuts off contact with the outside world, it causes disruptions to the sun system during that time. Kaguyamon is responsible for protecting the mountains that make up most of Shambala. It has the ability to open gates to faraway places or Digital Worlds of other dimensions, and transports its targets, enveloped in light, via bamboo that appears at their destinations. Since it dispatches many of its subordinate Digimon to locations where strange phenomena have occurred, bamboo groves are said to form at sites where gates have been opened. Ryugumon oversees the seas of Ashino Island and resides in Ryushogu, an oceanic area. It is revered as the lord of Ryushog

The Three Head Officers (三元士, Sangenshi) (Dub: Three Generals) is a group of three mighty Digimon designated as great military leaders. The three initially served as senior commanders of the Bagra Army under Bagramon, each competing to become his successor. During the war for control of the Digital World, they direct the army's forces and seek the 108 fragments of the Code Crown. Although they share a rank, they differ considerably in their methods: Tactimon relies on strategy, Lilithmon on cunning and sorcery, and Blastmon on overwhelming strength. The Three Head Officers were collectively described as "Demon Lord-class enemies" (魔王クラスの敵, Maō Kurasu no Teki) in promotional material for an event-exclusive battle in Digimon Xros Wars Super Digica Taisen. =Members= =Appearances=
Burning blood was a transmutation spell used by dragons. It struck back at attackers with blood suffused by the caster's breath weapon.

]] A griffin is a legendary creature with the body of a lion and the head and wings of an eagle. As the lion was considered the "King of the Beasts" and the eagle the "King of the Air", the griffin was thought to be an especially powerful and majestic creature. The griffin is generally represented with four legs, wings and a beak, with eagle-like talons in place of a lion's forelegs and equine ears jutting from its skull. The griffin was the House symbol for House Harkonnen.

Idaho was the surname of a family which dated back to the Butlerian Jihad. Originally, the most important member of the family was Swordmaster Anari Idaho, who served as the chief lieutenant of Butlerian Leader Manford Torondo. Duncan Idaho, another Swordmaster, who replaced her, did not come for ten thousand years, but was one of the most important people in the history of the Known Universe.
The Bulwark of the Great Dragon was a unique enchanted tower shield created out of bones and scaled of an ancient dragon by Darson sometime before 1372 DR.

Omnius was the self-proclaimed title of the collection of powerful artificially intelligent entities which tyrannically ruled the Synchronized Empire prior to and during the Butlerian Jihad, and later the reborn thinking machine civilisation, the New Synchronized Empire beyond the Old Imperium. Though Omnius instances existed on many worlds, each one evolving subtle differences, all instances were bound by a synchronizing process that saw them share the collective experiences of their counterparts. Thus they were frequently referred to as a single being. Omnius was often cited as the cause of the mankind's long-standing revulsion of technology, particularly computers. In 1182 BG, Omnius' machine network had been granted enough power to take Ix from Xerxes and end the Time of Titans with the rise of a new Synchronized Empire, whilst launching a war of attrition against the serious human resistance of the League of Nobles that resulted in a permanent stalemate. In 203 BG, he made serious gains with a pyrrhic victory for the League in the First Battle of Zimia and a brutal conquest of Giedi Prime, dispatching thousands of deepspace probes into the galaxy to establish machine bases, but soon lost Giedi and faced a major human slave rebellion on Earth by 201 BG. This escalated into a fanatic century-long Butlerian Jihad being declared by the League, beginning with the nuclear annihilation of the thinking machine capital in the Battle of Earth and their relocation to Corrin. In the

Supreme Sorceress was the title used by the leader of the Sorceresses of Rossak prior to the establishment of the Bene Gesserit. Probably the most famous was Zufa Cenva, who led the women of Rossak during the Butlerian Jihad. After Zufa's sudden death the title passed briefly to her daughter, Ticia Cenva. When Ticia died on Rossak toward the end of the Jihad, the title unofficially went to Raquella Berto-Anirul.

Beholders are vast floating heads studded with writhing eyestalks. They are the creation of the daelkyr, the lords of the plane of Xoriat. When the daelkyr invaded Eberron, they created the beholders as part of their armies. When the daelkyr were pushed back to Xoriat by the Gatekeepers, most of the beholders were pushed back to Xoriat as well. However, some remain on Eberron, hidden within the Khyber, being worshiped by Cults of the Dragon Below, waiting for their revenge.

The Cabal of Purple was an organization in Deep Imaskar, within the Lowerdark. They had been the ones to train Ususi Manaallin as a wizard. Ususi became convinced that she would not be brought down by a single Imaskari vengeance taker.
Aasterinian is the draconic god of invention and trade. It is also the name of a constellation in the skies of Eberron. Aasterinian is the messenger of Io, and a dragon god in her own right.
Carralag is a gargoyle native of Sharn and a racer for the Fallen and Malleon's Gate districts in the yearly Race of Eight Winds event..
Azers are fire-wreathed dwarf-like creatures native to the plane of Fernia. Azers have also been spotted on the Volcanic Fields of Xen'drik.

Calandor was a human duchy on the Sword Coast that existed from 697 DR to 947 DR, created from the destruction of the kingdom of Delimbiyran. Over the centuries it outlasted the other successor realms and eventually become the duchy of Daggerford.
Countess Arcticine is an eladrin noble of the Feywild's Winter Court.
The Beast of Bel Shalor is a fire reaver that serves the Shadow in the Flame. It possessed the young cleric Marguerite Dryden and corrupted the Silver Flame Catacombs of Stormreach.

Cutface the Tyrannosaurus is a swordtooth titan raised from birth by a tribe of halflings on the Talenta Plains. He has grown to full size under the guidance of the tribe, and will frequently hunt with the tribe, usually under the lead of the ranger named Moonlight. Cutface is fiercely devoted to Moonlight and her tribe.
Caldreth's Pickles, Nuts, and Foods was a small shop and secret sanctuary for the Harpers in Mornbryn's Shield in the Savage Frontier in the late 15 century DR.
Crystalline trolls are a type of troll whose bodies appear to be made of rock crystal.

Dragon turtles are powerful aquatic dragon-like creatures that resemble massive turtles. They are considered among the most dangerous aquatic creatures in existence. Dragon turtles are considered a type of lesser dragon.
Denkirk is a captain in the Cyran army during the Last War who commanded a warforged colossus.
The Cadorna family sword was an enchanted commemorative greatsword created for the famous, or rather infamous "dragon killer family" of Phlan, House Cadorna.
Frost salamanders are a type of magical creature found in Risia and particularly cold regions of the Material Plane.
Fire giants are militaristic giants who live near volcanoes and mountains in Xen'drik.
Dragonnes, also known as liondrakes, are fierce creatures that combine the characteristics of giant lions and brass dragons.
Burlane was the leader of the Company of the Bright Spear in the mid-14 century DR.

Giants are powerful beings that are native to the continent of Xen'drik. Once the rulers of a mighty empire during the Age of Giants, their civilization was destroyed by the dragons. They still roam the continent of Xen'drik, but their power has been vastly reduced.
Geth is shifter fighter veteran of the Last War living in the Eldeen Reaches.
Ice devils or gelugons are a kind of devil found in Risia, an insectoid horror promising a cold death.
A caduceus was a symbol associated with healing, consisting of a staff intertwined by two snakes, their coils looping back and forth, with two feathered wings at its top.
Girallons are aggressive, carnivorous apes with four arms. They are incredibly strong and territorial.

Major Talberg commanded the 15th Artillery Company at the beginning of the war, and was deployed to Germany's eastern border when the Russian land offensive began. After suffering heavy casualties following massive Russian airstrikes, Talberg and his men became experts at scavenging damaged artillery units - even captured enemy guns - to keep the unit combat capable. They are capable of sustaining damage that would destroy lesser units, yet keep on firing. AMZ-60 Huntsman.png|AMZ-60 Huntsman
The Corrupted Wyrm is an enemy exclusive class introduced in Fire Emblem Engage. A Corrupted dragon that serves Sombron, it acts as the counterpart to the Phantom Wyrm.
A caduceus staff was a type of magical staff, so named for being in the shape of the caduceus symbol, that had minor curative effects.
Cursed Expulsion is the Unique Action Ability of Lysithea in Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes.
Eda is a playable character from Fire Emblem: Thracia 776. A 21 year old Dragon Rider from Thracia, she is the younger sister of Deen.

Eliu is an enemy character from Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. She is one of the members of Duke Bloom's sister magi squad, consisting of herself, Vampa and Fetra. Each of the sisters specializes in a particular type of magic, Eliu's being Thunder. The three sisters appear in both Chapters 7 and 8, and will die in the latter chapter while facing off against Seliph's army.
Cairos was a fighter-thug and an Envoy of Stone Lord, who opposed the The Guild crime gang of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Faceless is an enemy-only Monster class that is first introduced in Fire Emblem Fates. Muscular humanoid beasts summoned into existence through fell magic, the Faceless employ their fists to clobber their foes.

The Five Heroes are the founders of the countries of Magvel who defeated the Demon King Fomortiis about 800 years before Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones by sealing him in one of the five eponymous Sacred Stones, divine treasures able to dispel evil. Only two of the Five Heroes are mentioned by name. The Five Heroes were: *Grado - Leader of the Five Heroes and founder of the Empire of Grado, the largest nation on the continent of Magvel. He wielded the Sacred Twins Gleipnir, the Dark Tome and Garm, the Black Axe. *???? - Founder of the Kingdom of Renais. Wielded the Sacred Twins Siegmund, the Flame Lance and Sieglinde, the Thunder Sword. *???? - Founder of the Kingdom of Frelia. Wielded the Sacred Twins Nidhogg, the Serpent Bow and Vidofnir, the Winged Lance. *???? - Founder of the Kingdom of Jehanna. Wielded the Sacred Twins Excalibur, the Swift Wind and Audhulma, the Ice Blade. *Latona - Founder of the Theocracy of Rausten. He is referred to as a Saint and was said to be the only one able to resist being possessed by the Demon King, Fomortiis. He wielded the Sacred Twins Ivaldi, the Glorious Light and Latona, the Saint's Staff. It is briefly mentioned in a couple of chapters and several support conversations that it was actually the Great Dragon Morva who led humanity to seal the Demon King, and this fact was only known by the Manakete tribe and the villagers of Caer Pelyn and was forgotten over time by the humans. The Five Heroes then placed the Sacred Stones in temples guar

Fjalar is a background character in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. She is one of the Twelve Crusaders that possesses the title of Mage Fighter, the original wielder of the Valflame tome and the founder of the Dukedom of Velthomer. During the events of the 2nd generation, her blood runs through Grannvale's royal family due to Arvis.
Burning Shield Lane was a road that crossed the entirety of The Shutters neighborhood in the Crow's End District of Ravens Bluff from north to south, and ended in the Pumpside neighborhood.
Freyr is a character from Book IV of Fire Emblem Heroes. He is a Vanir, and king of Ljósálfheimr, the realm of dreams. He is the god who governs dreams. He wishes for all to live in tranquility.
Hong Hua is a playable character in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. She is a powerful mage who fights alongside Eshmel to defeat Balor.

Katri is a major playable character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. She is the Shaman of Fire and therefore can use the Ring of Salia to transform herself into the holy Fire Dragon, Neuron. She is being pursued by Gwenchaos and his followers because she is one of the four shamans required as sacrifices to resurrect the dark dragon, Gerxel. Like Enteh, Katri must be deployed in every chapter in which she is available. If she is defeated, this will result in a Game Over.
Calantha was a member of Ship Rethnor of Luskan in the late 15 century DR.

Laevatein is an antagonist from Fire Emblem Heroes. She is a princess from the Kingdom of Múspell, Surtr's daughter and Laegjarn's younger sister. She is seen fighting Alfonse in the opening cinematic.

Limstella is an enemy character in Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. They are the most powerful of the morphs created by Nergal, and ostensibly the most powerful magic-wielding foe in the game other than Nergal himself. Limstella bears an impassive nature and is totally loyal to their master.

Martel is the boss of Chapter 18A in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade. He captured Niime to cast a spell which is said to have been lost centuries ago to cause rainfall in snowy Ilia and confuse Roy's army. Niime instead casts spell that made the rivers freeze over, allowing Roy's army to advance more quickly. His sprite is a recolor of Oro's. He shares this trait with another boss, Windham.
Call weaponry was a psionic power of the psychoportation discipline and its teleportation subdiscipline that manifested a weapon into the hands of the psionics user.

Meriah is a playable character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. She is the daughter of Naris and Rose, and the younger sister of Rishel. She is also the only character capable of wielding ☆Starlight and ☆Aura Rain.
Mighty King of Legend is the Personal Ability of Nemesis in Fire Emblem: Three Houses. It grants him immense power from the presence of his compatriots, the Ten Elites.

Octavas is a background character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. He was a priest from Salia, the Sage of Fire, and one of the Four Sages who was among the Twelve Heroes in the Leda Liberation War. He was the father of Andre, Rose, Clarice, and Liza, as well as the grandfather of Renee, Rishel, Meriah, Verna, Mahter, Frau, Holmes, and Sasha. Prior to the game's events, he was killed by Gwenchaos with the forbidden ★Zahhak spell.
Carsomyr was a powerful two-handed holy avenger sword found in Firkraag's "hoard" in his subterranean lair within the realm of Amn.

Rajaion is a non-playable character who is seen near the very end of Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance. He was a member of the Dragon tribe Laguz, and the first Goldoan prince. He is the brother of Kurthnaga and Almedha.
Rumel is a Dracoknight boss in Book 2 of Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem and its remake. He is a member under Lykke's rebellion army and assisted him by overthrowing Princess Minerva.

The Tomb Lord is an enemy-only Monster class that is first introduced in Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. It is the corpse of a highly powerful and vastly skilled hero of yore, and it utilizes its claws to deadly effect. They could be considered a sort of "third-tier" equivalent or even an Overclass of the Revenant/Entombed class line.

A carrack was a large, multi-masted sailing ship used in Amn and elsewhere on the Sword Coast. It could carry many soldiers and was capable of deep-sea voyages. Carracks had both fore and aft castles on the main deck. Cordell had several carracks in his fleet on his Maztican expedition. A carrack sailed the waters of the Whamite Isles, at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

|-|Lore= =Lore= Artificial Machine Intelligence Engine, shortened to as AMIE is a lore character introduced in Chapter 3: Season 3. She's an unkillable AI assistant created by The Scientist running on quantum drive. She is a major character in Fortnite: Battle Royale, serving as a one of the deuteragonists of Chapter 3: Season 3, Chapter 3: Season 4, Chapter 4: Season 1, Chapter 7: Season 1 and Chapter 7: Season 2.

Banshee is a character in Fortnite: Save the World. Her model is used in the following: *Special Forces Banshee Special Forces Banshee (Rare) - Hero - Save the World.png|Rare Special Forces Banshee (Epic) - Hero - Save the World.png|Epic Special Forces Banshee (Legendary) - Hero - Save the World.png|Legendary
The Storm King, commonly abbreviated to as MSK, is a boss Monster in Fortnite: Save The World. It can be found in Twine Peaks.
A caravel was a medium-sized sailing ship used in Amn and Waterdeep and on the Inner Sea by Cormyr, Sembia, and Impiltur. They were less popular in Turmish and Chondath.

Ned is a time-travelling Survivor in Fortnite: Save The World, who requests a Medkit most of the time you encounter him. He may also be seen as an on-foot Survivor. It was revealed in the Long Road Home Questline that he was supposedly present when somebody "broke time", resulting in him being trapped in a time loop and teleporting to various places throughout Time.

|-|Lore= =Lore= Revin the Cube (also known as Kevin) was a red-colored Cube that first appeared in OG Chapter 1: Season 5. It is a sentient being of unknown origin with malicious intentions. It is an alternate reality/timeline counterpart of Kevin the Cube who was affected by the unstable Sideways Rift opened by The Visitor during OG Chapter 1: Season 4. It was later summoned during the Zero Hour Live Event, serving as an ally of circumstance against the Dark Presence and ultimately destroying him at the cost of his life. It is a major character in Fortnite OG and Fortnite: Battle Royale, serving as the main antagonist of OG Chapter 1: Season 5 and OG Chapter 1: Season 6 and a supporting character in Zero Hour.
Spitfire is a Character in Fortnite: Save the World, and a as a Hero in-game.
Catalan Bree was a human male cleric of Selûne. In the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, he led the small temple of Moonwater in the town of Ylraphon in the Vast, with four subordinate clerics.
Whirlwing Scorch is an , , and in Fortnite: Save the World. He can be obtained from available during the Flannel Falls Venture Season. He is part of the Lunar New Year Heroes Set.
Orion (Greek: Ὠρίων) was a giant huntsman from Greek mythology. He is an available playable character in the multiplayer mode of God of War: Ascension.
Miklimunnr is a fire troll that appears as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök.

Major Cargunn was the proprietor of the well-stocked Major Cargunn's Military and Equipment Shoppe in Eshpurta, Amn, in the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR. He was a retired officer of the local Shield Militia but rumors said he had certain "expertise" that kept him involved with Militia operations.

Magni, an Aesir Demigod and the eldest son of Thor, carried a huge sword that is hardened by cyclonic thunder as his main weapon. Magni wielded the blade against Kratos but fell at the Spartan's hands.
The Stone Ancient was an Ancient that could be encountered in God of War (2018) as a boss.

Travelers are powerful armored knights that appear in God of War (2018) and God of War Ragnarök, acting as mini bosses. There is a former Traveler named Birgir, who acts as an ally to Freyr and the rest of the Vanir Gods.
Callum was a male dwarf and a member of the Neverwinter Nine on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.
Vísi Haglkorn is an ice troll that appears in God of War Ragnarök as an optional boss Kratos can fight.
Alhammarret was a sphinx mind mage from Vryn, who tutored and was later killed by Jace Beleren.

Barrin was a legendary Master Wizard, husband of Rayne and the father of Hanna, who possessed an extremely high ability to learn and utilize magic. He aided Urza in the defense of Dominaria from its Phyrexian invaders.
Carrackus was a male scrag and a pirate on the Sword Coast under the command of Pinochet.
Beledros Witherbloom is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Witherbloom College is named in her honor. She is a master of the forces of life and death.
Lady Beluna Grandsquall is a Giant noble woman from Stormkeld, Eldraine.
Baron Bertram Graywater is a vampire noble from an unknown plane.
Carbos was an assassin who operated on the Sword Coast during the mid–14 century DR.
Bori Andon is a well-respected Nivix guildmage and Izzet blastseeker on Ravnica, highly skilled but incredibly reckless. He was at one point on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.
Brannon is a young pyromancer acolyte in Keral Keep on the plane of Regatha.
Bernatheen was a Wizard Savant before Reveka's time, who infamously made Eron the Relentless immortal and was turned into a werewolf by Baron Sengir.

The Carnath Roadhouse was a compound and small supply depot found near the Mere of Dead Men along the High Road on the Sword Coast between Waterdeep in the south and Neverwinter in the north, in the late 15 century DR. In the 1480s DR, it was used by the Cult of the Dragon as a waypoint to transfer stolen goods to a secret location in the Mere, that is, Castle Naerytar, via an underground tunnel leading from the a trap door in the floor of the strong room.
Chandra Nalaar is a human planeswalker from Avishkar. She is a member of the Gatewatch.

Colfenor was one of the most ancient and wisest treefolk sages on the plane of Lorwyn. He was the only and last living red yew treefolk. The yew treefolk were powerful shamans, and their poison magic, one of the strongest types of magic overall, was unequalled on Lorwyn.
Dew, also known as the Cloudhoof Kirin, is one of the five legendary kirin kami from Kamigawa that are known to meet with each other every 1,000 years.
Carmen was a human fighter adventuring in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Eight-and-a-Half-Tails (), born Wise-Muzzle, was the highest spiritual leader of the kitsune on the plane of Kamigawa.

Elesh Norn (Phyrexian: Ducg,norn, IPA: [ʔelʃ norn]) was the Praetor of the white-aligned Machine Orthodoxy, which led New Phyrexia. She was called The Mother of Machines, Grand Praetor, or Grand Cenobite by her followers. As the ruler of New Phyrexia, she oversaw the New Phyrexian Invasion of the Multiverse, achieving full or partial conquests of numerous worlds. However, despite early successes, she was thwarted in the final battle by a combined coalition of Planeswalkers, Mirran rebels, and the war hosts of Zhalfir. She was subsequently killed by Karn.
Edgar Markov is the founder of the Markov bloodline, and the first vampire of Innistrad.
Carrier current was a common spell used by wizards in Serôs.

Baron Eckhart Von Falkenrath was a leading member of the Falkenrath vampire bloodline on Innistrad. For many years, he was in league with the planeswalker Sifa Grent after she possibly killed his brother for disobeying her.

Draco was a powerful artifact dragon that appeared on Dominaria during the first Phyrexian invasion. It is not known what Draco is or originally was, but the artwork suggests that it might have been a natural dragon (instead of a pure artificial construct) that was later modified by the Phyrexians with certain metallic parts,. Despite this, it is not itself defined as a Phyrexian creature, and neither is Scion of Draco.

Eusomoné was a minotaur of Hurloon on Dominaria. He was also called "Sings Two Ways," and once befriended Adam Carthalion. Eusomoné was later summoned by Jared Carthalion to fight off one of Ravidel's giant spiders in Arathoxia; he gave Jared the Foecleaver, and returned home to be healed of the spider's poison he was afflicted with from the battle.
Cast-off armor was armor that was magically enchanted to become exceedingly quick for its wearer to doff.
Ertai was a talented, arrogant young wizard from Tolaria who signed on to be the Skyship Weatherlights mage. He was resurrected during the second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.
Pierakor az Vinrenn D'rav, better known as Feather, is a Boros Firemane angel, who spent much time as Agrus Kos's partner.
Florian Voldaren is a vampire noble from Innistrad. He is of the Voldaren bloodline.
A catapult was a large ranged weapon typically used to lay siege to a fortified structure. They were also mounted on ships for naval combat as well as on spelljammers for battles in space.
Gadwick, the Wizened, is a human wizard of Eldraine. He is the powerful and mysterious archmage of Vantress. He is the master of the apprentice mage Johann.

Glissa Sunseeker, called Glissa Sunslayer after her compleation, was a powerful elf warrior on Mirrodin who sought to avenge her family's murder. As a Phyrexian, she now serves as Vorinclex's steward.
Grakmaw was a massive hydra horror that lurked for centuries in the shadows of a fallen Skyclave on Jwar Isle in Ondu, Zendikar.
Caster's shield was the enchanted shield created by Janice Whentom specifically to be helpful to warrior-wizards in battle.
Himoto, nicknamed Pompon by her planeswalker companion Kaito Shizuki, is the Kami of the Spark from Kamigawa.
Hylda of the Icy Crown is a powerful witch from Eldraine. She is the sister of Agatha, Eriette, and an unnamed witch who was the birth mother of the Kenrith twins.

Jacques le Vert was a legendary human warrior who lived in ancient times on Dominaria, before the Brothers' War. He abandoned his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, his homeland, and devoted all of his life to protecting its creatures. His legendary battle against The Brute in front of the tree city was represented on mosaics from the College of Lat-Nam. He was the first to bear the ancient Sword of the Meek, which has the ability to return from the graveyard. Even if after the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria the lush greenery of Pendelhaven has withered, the Pendelhaven Elder still carries the ancestral mantle of Jacques and continues his mission: to protect the creatures of his homeland.
Castle Exeltis was the Exeltis family keep and a winery, located in the Blade Cliffs of Sword Coast North.
Jarga is a massive troll who was part of Vraska's coup to take over leadership in the Golgari Swarm.

Jehadt was the warder of Gordahn, a proud keraunomancer who prepared for the right to stand for the village in the wizards' duel of Mirrankkar. However, on the day before the duel, the planeswalkers Mezlok and Taishiar walked into the village, and the village's leader announced that Mezlok would be the village's champion. Outraged, Jehadt challenged Mezlok for the right to represent the village, but Mezlok defeated him easily, despite Jehadt's Circle of Protection: Red. He was the great-grandson of Minoch.

Kaervek (KAIR-vehk) the Merciless is a black-aligned human warlock from Dominaria. He was the main antagonist of the Mirage block storyline. Kaervek's lifetime is longer than a normal human's, likely due to his magic, and he was already centuries old by the time the Mirage War started.
Castisha was the first mate on a ship that plied the Sea of Swords in the late 15 century DR.
Kazuul is an ogre slave-master living on the Murasa continent of Zendikar.
Kaito is a human cyber Ninja and Planeswalker from Kamigawa. He made his debut in Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty.
Junji is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. He is the reincarnation of Kokusho.
Carlon Amoffel was an agent of the Harpers that operated throughout the Sword Coast, and was tasked with investigating the Cult of the Dragon in the late 15 century DR.

Kreig was the Witch King of Keld on Dominaria. He was the most powerful Keldon of all time; the product of Gatha's genetic splicing of Keldon and Phyrexian stock. His power was great enough for the Phyrexians to take notice and attack Keld. He led his nation in numerous battles against the invaders; in one battle he encountered the Phyrexian Inner Circle member, Croag. Kreig wounded him but could not defeat him. He and Gatha jumped off a cliff, committing suicide so as not to fall into the hands of the Phyrexians.
Kraum, Ludevic's Opus, is a legendary zombie horror from Innistrad.
Khorvath Brightflame and Sylvia Brightspear are a dragon and human knight pair from the plane of Kylem.
Canaulé was a type of pastry found in the Sword Coast in the 15 century DR.

Macher is a human cathar on Innistrad. He had doubts about Avacyn's divinity, and his prayer that she be true summoned her to him. But Avacyn had already begun her descent into madness. Instead of comforting Macher, she intimidated him thoroughly, leaving him to scream and cower in her shadow as she flew away. He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.
Lyra Dawnbringer is an angel Commander of the Serra Angels of the Order of Dawn and Protector of Benalia on Dominaria.
Rodolf Duskbringer is a legendary vampire angel from Dominaria introduced in Jumpstart 2022.
The Caravanserai of the Twisted Sword was a small caravanserai located in the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Seshiro (SAY-shee-roh or SEHSH-ee-roh) called the Anointed, was a snake monk, and Broodmaster of the Orochi colonies of Kamigawa during the Kami War.
Seble is a Zendikari skyrider elf, part of Gideon's forces during the Battle for Zendikar.

Talibah of Emberwilde is an embermage from Dominaria. She was a member of the Mages of the Emberwilde Order, a group of Suq'Ata mages who pledged their allegiance to the djinn and efreet of Wildfire. Talibah is a thug with power. However, her tone becomes very enlightened and "less aggressive" when referring to Wildfire. Wildfire was instrumental in defending Suq’Ata against Kaervek during the Mirage Wars when it commanded its sorcerers, djinn, efreets, and spirits against the dark legions. Indeed, as the Suq’Ata shrank into their empire, it was the power of the Emberwilde that helped maintain their closed border.
Captain's Cutlass was a unique sword wielded by the avatar of Valkur, the Captain of the Waves.
Svogthir, called the "god-zombie," was the parun of the Golgari Swarm on the plane of Ravnica.

Talrand is a Merfolk wizard who rules beneath the waves of the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar. He challenged the dominion of the dragon Kalyntri above the sea. The mage seems equally comfortable on the ground as in the seas, wields a large assortment of blue spells, and has the power to summon drake servants. They serve him in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons. In a concerted effort, Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.
Tanazir Quandrix is one of the five elder dragons from Arcavios that founded Strixhaven. The Quandrix College is named in her honor. She is a master of the magics that govern reality and abstraction.

The Captain's helmet was a unique enchanted helmet crafted by Laeral Silverhand for Tommus Tallstep in the late 15 century DR. It was one of many pieces of so-called "Silverhand gear" crafted for adventurers who helped to protect Waterdeep.

Tetsuo Umezawa (oo-meh-ZAH-wah) was the imperial champion of the Empire of Madara around the time of the Mirage War. He was trained in many martial arts and magical techniques and was arguably the most powerful human of his time. Raised with a strict honor code, he was oft torn between his honor and his master, the vicious emperor of Madara, Nicol Bolas.

The Guardians original name is unknown. He was an apprentice to Kenan Sahrmal, the protector of Shandalar, who had been training the future Guardian and Azar since his apparent death at the hands of Lim-Dûl.
Tayam is a legendary nightmare beast from the plane of Ikoria.
Captain Herab's leather armor was a unique enchanted light armor worn by Captain Herab who sailed the Sea of Swords in the late 14 century DR.
Tenri is a Kor healer and leader from Zendikar, active during the Battle for Zendikar.
Saint Traft was a young priest in the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad. He is now a geist.

Tovolar is a powerful werewolf on the plane of Innistrad and the main antagonist of the Innistrad: Midnight Hunt storyline. He was the alpha werewolf of the Mondronen howlpack before their disbandment and later became the leader of the Dire pack.
Carngaur was a caravan guard in the Sword Coast during the mid-14 century DR.

Thraximundar is a brutal undead warrior from Alaran Grixis who lives to slay. He is fully seven feet tall and rippling with dead muscle, clad in dreadful spiked armor and wielding a greatsword. Astride his massive dreg reaver mount like some dark parody of a knight, Thraximundar - whose name means "he who paints the earth red" - is drawn to the sounds and emotions of mass violence. He never takes sides - he slays anyone, taking grim pleasure in the pure act of war itself.
Toggo is a goblin artificer from Dominaria and the self-proclaimed inventor of and lightning.
Tivit, the Seller of Secrets, is a Sphinx rogue from Capenna. They are a seer for the Obscura.
Cassivora Dophir was a Gur monster hunter from the tribe led by Ulma that traveled along the Sword Coast and Western Heartlands during the late 15 century DR.
Tover Giants-Blood is a giant human warrior, who faced down the much smaller Arni Brokenbow and lost.

Artifacts known as Triskelions were artificial creatures created by Tawnos while he was working as Chief Scholar in Penregon. Used as sentinels and mobile fortifications, They had three legs that could skewer an enemy. They could see in three directions at once and were optimally designed for agility, mobility, and lethality. It proved its usefulness and versatility in many of the later battles between Urza and Mishra.
Turg was a massive anurid frog beast employed by Ambassador Laquatus on Dominaria.
Cassandra Rulmac was a half-elf fighter/wizard and adventurer and a member of the Company of the Sundered Orc in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Veyran, Voice of Duality is an efreet wizard teacher at the Prismari College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

Yawgmoth (Phyrexian: wUDkmoDZ, IPA: [jɒʔgmoʔθ], lit. "Machine Father"), also known as The Ineffable to his servants and referred to as The Lord of the Wastes throughout Dominarian mythology, was the god and progenitor of the Phyrexian race. Originally human, in his early life he was a medical genius of the ancient Thran Empire known for his highly controversial solutions to medical ailments.

Élan d'Avenant was an archer squire of the Order of the D'Avenant on Dominaria. To seal an alliance with the town of Hamath, she was to kill Jared Carthalion, who was believed to be a minion of Ravidel. However, before she could kill him, Kristina of the Woods took him away. Élan followed Jared and Kristina to the White Woods, but was prevented from killing Jared when the tree she hid in shook due to Exarch Amadis' magic during the battle against the Calthyn Elves, sending her to the ground. Jared accidentally summoned her during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerated her.
The Captain's Pride was a freelance cargo ship, owned by its captain, that operated in the waters of the Dragon Reach in the mid–14 century DR.

Zirilan of the Claw was an old viashino warlord from the Great Desert on Jamuraa (Dominaria). He was an ally of Jolrael and Hivis of the Scale. While Hivis bent the dragons of Jamuraa to his will, Zirilan forged a pact with the dragons, brokering peace between their tribes. Once he had established a sacred martial treaty, Zirilan could lead them into battle. He was a very ingenious commander, knowing how best to exploit the mighty strength at his command. He joined the side of Jolrael and Kaervek in the Mirage War, but after Jolrael defected he retreated into the Great Desert. The treaty established by Zirilan has held for centuries, with Jamuraa's current Claw being Rivaz.
Xolatoyac, "the Smiling Flood," is a salamander serpent in Ixalan's Core.
The Feather Dragon (フェザードラゴン) also known as Fenn is one of the Sacred Beasts of Lacroa in SD Gundam Force.
Carliela Benstyl was a human rogue and fighter and leader of the Merchants' Guild of Velprintalar (now known as Old Velprintalar) in 1374 DR. She was an influential member of the Sons of Hoar.
The Griffin is one of the four Sacred Beast from Lacroa in Superior Defender Gundam Force.

Gundam Sarutahiko is a life-form from the planet of Reuniss that appears in Mobile War History Gundam Burai. It gained the title of "Gundam" which is given to the warriors of its planet before it rebelled and was exiled to Earth, where it was sealed after a battle against Humans and Gundam Ninigi. As the first and original Gundam, the human-made Gundams are Tetsuki that attempt to imitate Sarutahiko. Using a human alter-ego called Ebisu, it manipulated events to release itself from the prison in Japan and restart its plan of becoming the God of Earth and building an army to conquer Reuniss.
M4AA2R BGR (Body Guard Radiobeam) is an unmanned remote-guided mobile suit appearing in the Go Ahead!! (Another War in UC 0044) manga.
Chainmail (also known as chain mail or simply chain) was a type of armor used on Toril.
The MSZ-006H Hyper Zeta Gundam Honoo (aka Hyper Zeta Gundam Flame) is a mobile suit from Gundam Build Fighters Honoo. It is controlled by Yusei Kouen.
The Steel Dragon (スティールドラゴン) is one of the Sacred Beasts of Lacroa in Superior Defender Gundam Force.

The Overwatch Elite or Combine Elite are specialized, higher-ranked Overwatch soldiers. With further augmentation compared to their standard counterpart, they represent the pinnacle of the transhuman Combine Overwatch and reserved for the highest priority missions to the Combine.
Changestaff was a transmutation or evocation and enchantment spell that made a specially prepared staff become a treant-like creature on command.
Voltigores (not to be confused with Vortigaunts) are large Race X creatures encountered in Half-Life: Opposing Force, which serve as mini-bosses throughout the game.
Petty Officer Adriana-111 was a SPARTAN-II super soldier and a member of Gray Team.

The father of Bornstellar-Makes-Eternal-Lasting was a powerful Forerunner Builder. He and his guild designed the Halo Array under the orders of the Master Builder. Standing four meters tall after his most recent mutation, Bornstellar noted that he bore a disturbing resemblance to the Master Builder.

Cephas was a skilled genasi fighter and a descendant of the el Arhapan. He was an earthsoul genasi who later manifested a windsoul in 1479 DR. He was the long-lost heir to Pasha Marod el Arhapan, the leader of Calimport in the mid-15th century DR.

Colony is the name chosen by a pair of Mgalekgolo bond brothers, who served within the Banished as commander of all its Lekgolo forces on the Ark. Although it ultimately defers command to Atriox, Colony possesses its own intentions for the Ark, having covertly deployed forces to the resting location of the remaining Forerunner Keyships on the installation without the knowledge or consent of any of the other Banished leaders. They serve as the main antagonists of Halo Wars 2: Operation: SPEARBREAKER.

Faber-Of-Will-And-Might, more commonly known by his title as the Master Builder, was an immensely powerful Forerunner Builder. He commissioned the construction of the Halo Array, and co-created Mendicant Bias alongside the Ur-Didact.

Master Chief Petty Officer John-117, more commonly known as Master Chief, is a SPARTAN-II commando of the UNSC Naval Special Warfare Command. He is the protagonist and main character in both the Halo trilogy and Reclaimer Saga. With over thirty years of active duty service, he has become one of the most decorated war veterans in the United Nations Space Command, earning every known UNSC medal except the Prisoner of War Medallion.
Ch'Chitl () was a city of mind flayers located about 18 mi (28.97 km) beneath the southernmost foothills of the Sword Mountains, close to Waterdeep.
Keiichi-047 was a SPARTAN-II Commando of the UNSC Naval Special Warfare Command. Keiichi-047 served during the Harvest Campaign in 2531.

Master Chief Petty Officer John-117, more commonly known as, Master Chief, is a member of the UNSC's Spartan program. He is also a member of FLEETCOM, the Asymmetric Warfare Research Group, leader of the Silver Team, and a Blessed One. John is Earth's most advanced warrior in the 26th century and the only hope of salvation for a civilization pushed to the brink of destruction by the Covenant, an unstoppable alliance of alien worlds committed to the destruction of humanity. While fighting to obtain the keystones from Covenant forces, Master Chief allowed Cortana to assume full control over his body to save the Spartans.
The Cavern of Cloven Heads was an ancient cavern, first inhabited by Clan Black Axe, which was close to Ched Nasad.

Monitors are highly advanced Artificial intelligence constructs created by the Forerunners over one hundred thousand years ago to occupy special positions in Forerunner society. One of the main purposes of a Monitor was to be the caretakers of the Halo Array as well as other installations (such as the maintenance of Line Installations) and to ensure that the virulent Flood remain imprisoned. Monitors are extremely intelligent, yet completely devoted to their original function, and are zealous about containing Flood; Monitors have been known to violently turn on their allies if they should attempt to violate their containment protocols. The Covenant refer to the Monitors as Oracles. Individual humans appear to use whatever names they deem appropriate; Sergeant Major Avery Johnson has referred to the Monitor 343 Guilty Spark as "light bulb," "tinker bell," and "robot," and both John-117 and Johnson simply shortened his name to "Spark."
Owen Uduike, aka Owen-B092 was a SPARTAN-III Program's super soldier who fought in the Battle of Meridian (2548).

Chachim was an assassin of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR.

Atticus is a Jiralhanae Chieftain in service of the Banished.

A catseye brooch was a small charm that provided luck for its carrier and protected them from disease. They were cast from silver and inset with a green chrysoberyl, also known as a cat's eye. They were popular in human societies with a significant Chondathan populace.
Charles-124 was a Spartan-II supersoldier in the United Nations Space Command.
Dan P. is a Spartan-IV supersoldier. Their service number is 33501-44183-DP. They graduated from the Avery J. Johnson Academy of Military Science.
